name: Big Roosta BBQ and Catering
eyebrow: BBQ, soul food and catering · Gulfport, Mississippi
tagline: Soul food, catfish, wings and ribs in Gulfport.
about: Big Roosta BBQ and Catering specializes in soul food, catfish, wings, ribs, smash burgers and bacon cheeseburger egg rolls. It also runs the Rolling Roosta food truck.
